title: Join with a code
thisBuild: Invite to edit now also shows a 10 letter code, big, under the button. On the other screen go to Settings, Account, type the code in the box and tap Join. No copying links.
The same box takes a pasted link, so nothing depends on what is on the clipboard any more. The web version could never read the clipboard; now it does not have to.
Still new: By note under Chop to pads, Join the slices, and Re-pitch for short sounds.
watch: Make an invite on the phone and type its code on the computer. Does Join open the same mess on both?
Tap pads on one screen: does the other one change?
limits: A code works once, for 7 days, like the link. Make a new one for each person.
Invites made before this build have no code; make a fresh one.
